title: Size & Value Portfolio Construction
question: How does a transparent size/value tilt compare with the broad market?
method: Use the six French value-weighted size/book-to-market portfolios. Fixed weights: 5/10/35/5/10/35%, in source column order. Rebalance monthly; cost 10bp per dollar bought or sold, including initial entry. Weights are illustrative design choices, not optimized. Report 2010–2025 separately from 2000–2009 context. Sharpe uses monthly RF; CAGR compounds net returns.
result: The tilt returned 12.30% annualized versus 14.06% for the market. The result demonstrates a style allocation trade-off; it does not establish stock-level selection skill.
limits: Research portfolio proxies are not directly tradable securities. Historical data are the September 2026 revised vintage, not a point-in-time archive. No claim of a previously untouched holdout or future alpha. Taxes and intra-portfolio trading costs are excluded.

title: Lagged Trend Strategy Backtest
question: Can a simple trend rule change the market drawdown profile?
method: At each month start, hold the market if its previous 12 completed monthly total returns compound above zero; otherwise hold the RF proxy. Signals exclude the current month. Charge 10bp per full allocation switch. Compare against buy-and-hold for 2010–2025; also report 2000–2009 context in the CSV. No parameter search.
result: Trend CAGR was 10.54%, with maximum drawdown -20.77%; market CAGR was 14.06% and drawdown -24.84%.
limits: Monthly execution assumes the signal can be implemented at the period boundary. Real execution delay, instrument tracking error and taxes are excluded. The market index is a research proxy. Historical evaluation is not a live or pristine holdout track record.
